## Current reproducible anchors

At audit time: 1,786 total items; 200 active; 1,601 parent edges; 1,137 dependency entries; 665 items with dependencies; 109 active dependency components; 100 active dependency isolates; longest active order-bearing path two edges; parent depth max four; no active normalized-title duplicate cluster; no active lifecycle cycle or dangling dependency endpoint.

These are baselines, not target quotas. The task must rerun and timestamp every measure when claimed.

## Deliverables

A counts-first report, machine-readable finding stream, waiver registry, explicit uncertainty queue, and exact proposed relationship operations for Wave 1.
Wave 0 graph baseline and waiver ledger: classify roots, active dependency isolates, legacy aliases, and body-to-edge drift
Publish a reproducible all-status graph baseline and classify every currently suspicious sparse or semantically ambiguous case before changing relationships.

Record snapshot identity, commands, schema and package versions, counts by status and type, parent-depth distribution, edge kinds, components, isolates, ordering depth, dangling endpoints, and history integrity; Classify all roots and active dependency isolates as intentional, governed sparse, incomplete, ambiguous, archived, or remediation debt with reason and reviewer state; Detect item bodies and comments that name explicit prerequisites or delivery links missing from dependency metadata and record source excerpts or event pointers without auto-mutating; Map related_to and other legacy aliases plus parent or child duplication into candidate canonical kinds while preserving uncertainty; Produce cursorable machine-readable findings and a compact summary whose limits, omissions, and snapshot are explicit; Run exact, fuzzy, and parent-scope duplicate scans plus validate, health, and history-drift checks; baseline creation makes no terminal-item mutations
Turn audit counts into a deterministic evidence and waiver ledger that later waves can safely execute
Every proposed graph change starts from a reviewed finding rather than a density target or intuition
Prevents synthetic links and makes reconstruction resumable, measurable, and multi-agent safe
Versioned baseline metrics, exact item classifications, waiver reasons, body-to-edge findings, and proposed remediation records
The current baseline has 185 hierarchy roots overall, 100 active dependency isolates, alias drift, and documented prerequisites absent from metadata

value.text:
Reproducible all-status graph census, 2026-08-04, taken directly from the tracked item files rather than from a graph command, so it is independent of read-time canonicalization and of the active-node scoping that pm-6olc95 owns.

Method. Parse every file under the per-type storage folders, both TOON dependency encodings, the tabular header form and the expanded list form. Reading only one encoding undercounts badly: the expanded form alone yields 855 rows and reads as a nearly edgeless corpus. Both forms together yield 9,152 rows across 2,301 items.

Authored edge totals by kind: related 5,512; implements 2,206; discovered_from 330; blocked_by 277; parent 275; blocks 241; verifies 200; supersedes 57; related_to 43; child 8; incident_from 3.

Timestamp coverage is 9,152 of 9,152, exactly 100 percent, with no kind and no month missing. Author coverage is 7,788 of 9,152, 85.1 percent, leaving 1,364 rows whose asserting identity is unrecoverable. Distribution by creation month is 2026-02 84, 2026-03 147, 2026-04 238, 2026-05 91, 2026-06 265, 2026-07 7,863, 2026-08 464. Eighty-six percent of the graph was authored in one month, which is the backfill, and it is the reason a HEAD-only reading overstates historical connectedness.

Connectivity by status, counting an edge as discriminating when its kind is not part of the hierarchy spine of parent, child, and implements:

Open, 331 items. Zero have no discriminating edge. Median total degree 11, median discriminating degree 10. The active frontier is saturated and needs no enrichment.

Closed, 1,956 items. 257 have no discriminating edge at all and participate solely through the hierarchy spine; by type they are Task 122, Issue 51, Feature 46, Chore 30, Story 6, Decision 2. A further set brings the total with at most one distinct discriminating kind to 1,364, which is 69.7 percent. Median total degree 4, median discriminating degree 3.

Canceled, 14 items. Zero have no discriminating edge. Median total degree 5.

Reading. The enrichment frontier is entirely inside terminal history, exactly where this plan already sequences it last and where pm-a8zm requires dedicated changelog-safe batches coordinated with pm-e9zh. The 257 spine-only closed items are the natural first wave boundary and the 1,364 at-most-one-kind set is the second. No edge was written to any closed item to produce this census, and none should be written outside those batches.

Two vocabulary observations that belong in the waiver ledger rather than in remediation. The related_to rows, 43 of them, are the alias population pm-4020c5 owns and are still being minted at HEAD. The blocks rows, 241 of them, are unmirrored without exception: not one has a reciprocal blocked_by on its target, which is the correct state under the current model and simultaneously the reason pm-jkbqt8 reports them unreachable to the scheduler. Both populations have grown since their owning items measured them, which is the general gap now filed as pm-ips23h.
